messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: paging.p99_streaming > SLO threshold in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 (aggregated). auto-escalation to eng-oncall. incident_id=INC-2026-37789 :rotating_light:
Mira (SRE): seeing p95 jump too, looks correlated with a kernel rollout ~10:02 UTC. large tail for streaming RPCs, connections stall ~300-500ms extra at p99.
Alex (runtime): confirmed, we had a TRT8+FlashAttn kernel pushed to canary nodes at 09:58. Canary was limited but routing bumped due to capacity.
Jordan (platform): rolling back canary now across both regions? I can kick a rollback for the canary autoscale group.
Lee (infra): hold on, need to preserve traces for root cause. If we rollback immediately we might lose required logs for decode path. Suggest snapshotting /var/log/inference and preserving GPU metrics for 15m then rollback.
Mira (SRE): Agreed. Alex, can you enable debug KV cache logs and inject trace_id sampling for affected model families? We need decode stack traces.
Alex (runtime): doing that now. Pushing a small flag to canary that increases log sampling for decode paths:
```
export TRACE_SAMPLING=0.2
export DECODE_DEBUG=1
systemctl restart inference-canary
```
Mira (SRE): noted. Capturing p99/p95 metrics in dashboard pinned: https://console.redwood-inference/ops/dashboards/paging-tail
support-bot: Customer impact notifier: 8 customers reported increased latency via support portal (ticket refs: #6742, #6747, #6751). Severity: degraded.
Jordan (platform): I started a rollback plan to revert kernel package to v2.11 on canary nodes. Rolling in 5m if no objection.
Alex (runtime): before rollback, quick experiment: on a canary, I repinned the runtime to the older compilepath and saw streaming p99 drop back ~220ms in short test. Looks compilepath-related.
Lee (infra): good signal. Capture the package sha: kernel-package sha=ab12f7c. New one is cf88e3d.
Mira (SRE): timeline so far: 09:58 canary kernel upgrade -> 10:02 p99 spike visible -> 10:06 alert. We'll keep that in the incident timeline.
Jordan (platform): rolling back now for eu-west-1 canary group. Patch notes: revert cf88e3d -> ab12f7c. Deploy command: `rollout revert --group canary-eu-west-1 --package cf88e3d`
Alex (runtime): quick note: TRT/FlashAttn config changed fallback path for certain seq_len patterns, causing extra compile invocation during decode which spikes tail. I've traced a busy loop in compilecache eviction.
Mira (SRE): Alex, can you push a temporary mitigator to disable runtime compile-on-demand and force use of precompiled kernels? That might reduce tail.
Alex (runtime): yes, pushing `COMPILE_ON_DEMAND=false` to canary runtime. Applying to eu-west-1 canary now.
support-bot: Customer-facing status page updated: "Investigating increased latency in EU/US regions".
Mira (SRE): after the revert + mitigator we'll need to watch p99 for 15m. If stable, escalate to full rollback for us-west-2.
Lee (infra): Snapshotting GPU traces to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-37789/ at 10:12 UTC.
Jordan (platform): us-west-2 rollback scheduled at 10:18 unless metrics indicate otherwise.
Alex (runtime): logs show compilequeue backlog spikes at same time as serving stalls. snippet: 
```
[10:01:58] compile_queue length=342 pending=312
[10:02:01] decode latency p99=820ms
[10:02:05] kernel compile start cf88e3d
```
Mira (SRE): impact assessment: estimated 5-10% queries hit p99 degradation, streaming sessions are the worst. Some customers reported truncated streams/timeouts. Need to coordinate CS outreach after we stabilize.
Jordan (platform): rollback complete for canary-eu-west-1 at 10:14. p99 dropped from 820ms -> 130ms in synthetic smoke tests. mirroring live metrics now.
Mira (SRE): metrics look better in eu-west-1. p99 is trending down but still watching p95 for regressions.
support-bot: Notifying affected customers: template queued, support will send once we have final impact and ETA.
Lee (infra): prepping a full cluster rollback playbook if us-west-2 mirrors eu-west-1. Also opening a ticket with our kernel build team to bisect the compilepath change.
Alex (runtime): initial hypothesis: a compiler flag introduced an aggressive in-memory codegen path that thrashes the NVCache for certain attention sizes causing paging. Candidate flag: `--use-fast-compile` enabled in cf88e3d.
Mira (SRE): Can build team supply a bisect window? Jordan, can you tag the build CI job and upload artifacts?
Jordan (platform): tagged job #build-9342, artifacts uploaded to ci.redwood/artifacts/build-9342. Notifying infra and builds.
Mira (SRE): handoff plan: if us-west-2 stabilizes after rollback we mark incident as mitigated but keep incident open for root cause. Assigning owners:
- RCA lead: Alex (runtime)
- Build bisect: Jordan (platform)
- Customer comms: Support team (cc: support-bot)
- Postmortem draft: Mira (SRE)
Alex (runtime): starting RCA now. First step: reproduce compilepath thrash in a controlled canary with stress harness.
Lee (infra): recommend capturing kernel symbols and GPU memory maps for reproducer. I'll coordinate with on-call infra.
Mira (SRE): end-of-handoff note: oncall shift change in 45m, leaving a clear next-steps list in incident doc. continuing to monitor p99/p95 in both regions.
support-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED (canary rollback reduced p99 spike). Incident remains open for RCA.
Mira (SRE): thanks team. Jordan/Lee/Alex, continue with bisect and reproducer. I'll draft initial customer note for review. :thumbsup:
